transient: the tracker's database is locked or busy (sqlite OperationalError); retried in code up to 3 times with backoff
permanent: the issue number does not exist
the number is not a positive integer (boundary)
an argument of the wrong type, missing or unknown (boundary)

transient: an I/O error reading the index or a file
permanent: the query is empty or only whitespace
the query is longer than 200 characters
path_glob is not a valid glob
an argument of the wrong type, missing or unknown, or an enum value outside its set (boundary)

transient: an I/O error reading the file
permanent: no file at the path, including a path that differs only in case (the error names the near matches)
the path is a directory
the path is under config/
the path leaves the repository (leading / or ..)
the file is not text
the path is empty (boundary)

transient: the tracker's database is locked before the write commits (sqlite OperationalError): nothing was written
permanent: the issue number does not exist
the body is empty or longer than 4,000 characters (boundary)
an argument of the wrong type, missing or unknown (boundary)
ambiguous: the write times out after it was dispatched (TrackerTimeout): the comment may or may not have been posted

transient: the tracker's database is locked before the write commits (sqlite OperationalError): nothing was written
permanent: the issue number does not exist
the branch is not repomind/issue-<number> (boundary)
the title is empty, longer than 120 characters or more than one line (boundary)
the body is empty or longer than 4,000 characters (boundary)
ambiguous: the write times out after it was dispatched (TrackerTimeout): the PR may or may not have been opened
